Description.Value:
NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: adds Vulture AR, Vulture Sniper and Vulture Sidearm, ten of each with ten clips.
Requires ContentTool. Nothing to run: enabling the mod publishes three model keys. All three weapons wear this mod's own art: ar181.glb, sniper.glb and nerf.glb. Their donors are SY_LaserAssaultRifle_WeaponDef, SY_LaserSniperRifle_WeaponDef and SY_LaserPistol_WeaponDef. The AR fires green Crabman-spitter blobs; the Sniper fires a blue 0.6-second beam; the Sidearm fires an orange beam with the flamethrower's muzzle effects. NOTHING is written into game files. Disabling un-publishes the model keys, but created defs remain until restart. NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: starting storage is not added to an existing save. They cannot be researched or manufactured.
